text: What is the purpose of this Memorandum of Understanding? The MOU aims to outline the terms and conditions for Creatrix's implementation of a custom nopCommerce theme, as detailed in the document you provided.
Who are the parties involved in this MOU? The Client is EMPR Australia Pty Ltd, located in Australia. The Partner is Creatrix Ventures LLC from the USA.

What does Creatrix's role include in the implementation of the nopCommerce theme? Creatrix will handle all aspects related to custom design and implementation (CSS, HTML), testing of frontend features, and overall project coordination for the nopCommerce theme. Backend development or changes are not covered under this scope.

What are the responsibilities of the Client in relation to Creatrix's work? The Client needs to provide all necessary images and contents required for the website, as delays in providing these can affect the project timeline. They also need to ensure any backend development or changes requested by Creatrix remain their responsibility.

How is the project timeline structured? Creatrix commits to completing the nopCommerce theme implementation within 145 hours, with the possibility of extension due to additional service requests, significant scope changes, or delays in client-provided data and resources.

What does 'Completion' mean for this project? 'Completion' is defined as delivering a fully functional and responsive theme that has been tested across modern browsers and devices, with all defects resolved, and received formal written acceptance from the Client.

How long will Creatrix ensure smooth website operation after handover? Creatrix will ensure smooth website operation for 1 month post-handover. Any additional work required due to out-of-scope requests will incur hourly billing and need prior written approval from the Client.

Who owns all designs, code, and deliverables created under this agreement? All design, code, and deliverables created by Creatrix within this agreement will become the sole property of EMPR once full payment is made.

How are development payments structured according to this MOU? Payment for the nopCommerce theme implementation will be made in two installments: 50% upon signing the contract and another 50% after completion of the project, prior to going live.

What warranties does Creatrix provide regarding their work? Creatrix warrants that all designs, code, and deliverables created during the term of this agreement will be free from any defects upon delivery. What is the purpose of this Memorandum of Understanding? The purpose of this MOU is to outline the terms and conditions under which Creatrix will implement a custom nopCommerce theme, as described in the MoU.
Who are the parties involved in this agreement? This MoU involves EMPR Australia Pty Ltd (Client) and Creatrix Ventures LLC (Creatrix).

What does Creatrix agree to deliver under this MOU? Creatrix agrees to deliver nopCommerce theme implementation on the frontend, which includes custom design and implementation (CSS, HTML), testing of frontend features, and overall project coordination.

Are backend changes included in the scope of work provided by Creatrix? No, backend development or changes are excluded from this scope and remain the responsibility of the Client’s Indian development team.

What happens if there is a delay in providing necessary information or resources by the Client? The project timeline may extend if there are delays in client-provided necessary information, approval, and resources.

How is the project completion defined according to this MOU? Completion is defined as delivery of a fully functional and responsive theme, tested across modern browsers and devices, with defects resolved, and formally reviewed and accepted by the Client in writing.

What is included in Creatrix's maintenance responsibilities after the project handover? Creatrix will ensure smooth website operation and fix reported bugs within 1 month of handover. Major maintenance such as new modules or design changes will be billed hourly.

Who owns all designs, code, and deliverables created by Creatrix under this agreement? All designs, code, and deliverables created by Creatrix under this agreement shall become the sole property of EMPR once full payment has been made.

How is payment for the project handled according to the payment terms? Development payments are paid in two installments: 50% upon signing the contract and 50% after project completion, prior to going live.

What happens if a request falls outside of the agreed scope or requires additional work? Any requests deemed out-of-scope will require a written change request. Creatrix will provide a revised estimate, and no additional work will be undertaken without prior written approval from the Client.

What does this Memorandum of Understanding cover? This MoU outlines the terms and conditions for the implementation of a custom nopCommerce theme, including roles, responsibilities, project timeline, maintenance, ownership of deliverables, and payment terms.

Who is responsible for backend development or changes? Backend development or any significant changes to the agreed scope of work are the responsibility of the Client’s Indian development team. Creatrix will focus solely on frontend implementation as per this MoU.

How many hours does Creatrix agree to complete the theme implementation project? Creatrix agrees to deliver the nopCommerce theme implementation within 145 hours, though this may extend if additional work is requested or delays occur in providing necessary information and resources.

What happens after the UAT step before final acceptance and payment? A formal User Acceptance Testing (UAT) step will be conducted by the Client prior to final acceptance of the theme, ensuring it meets all requirements before payment is finalized.

How long does Creatrix guarantee website operation after handover? Creatrix guarantees smooth website operation and bug fixing for 1 month post-handover. Any major maintenance or design changes will be billed on an hourly basis.

Can any out-of-scope requests be accepted without approval? No, any requests deemed out of scope require a written change request. Creatrix will provide revised estimates and won’t undertake additional work unless prior written approval is obtained from the Client.

What happens to all designs and code created under this agreement? All designs, code, and deliverables created by Creatrix under this agreement shall become the sole property of EMPR Australia Pty Ltd once full payment has been made.
How are payments structured according to this MoU? Payments will be made in two installments: 50% upon signing the contract, and another 50% after project completion, prior to going live.

What does Creatrix provide for warranties and liability? Creatrix warrants that all designs, code, and deliverables created under this agreement are free from defects once full payment has been made. They also warrant against any loss or damage arising directly from their work.

Are there specific descriptions of the cost breakdown for nopCommerce Theme implementation? The cost breakdown includes a single item with an estimate of 145 hours at $35 per hour, totaling $5075. No additional services or costs are mentioned in this breakdown.
